raw_response:
I am not farming a big place, only 10.9 mu, so I cannot spread money everywhere. I will keep doing what has worked for me: most of the land stays in wheat-maize, because that gives grain twice and feels safer, and a smaller piece stays in cotton for cash. I will put about 7 mu in wheat-maize and 3.9 mu in cotton. I do not like to cut fertilizer too hard, because if the crop turns weak, the loss is bigger than the money saved, but I also cannot spend too much at once, so I split fertilizer and watch the crop. We have well water, but pumping costs money, so I irrigate at the important times, not too many times. Some people in the family work outside, so for busy days, especially cotton picking, I may need a little hired help.
